description: Use this when the user wants a group to vote or pick between options: a poll, a ranked-choice vote, approval voting, choosing a date, venue, book or name. Publishes a voting page that people open from a link in any browser, and returns a public link to share and a private organizer link. Methods: single (pick one), approval (pick any), ranked (instant runoff). 2 to 20 options, up to 300 voters. Not for secret ballots, formal elections, or anything that needs identity checks or fraud protection.

hide_results_until_closed.description: true hides the totals from voters until the organizer closes the vote; default false (totals visible).

method.description: single = pick one (default); approval = tick every option you like; ranked = rank in order, counted by instant runoff. Example: ranked.

note.description: Optional short note shown above the form, up to 300 characters, e.g. Vote by Friday 6 pm.

options.description: 2 to 20 options in display order, each up to 80 characters, e.g. ["Thai", "Pizza", "Sushi"].

question.description: The question people vote on, up to 200 characters, e.g. Where should we have the team dinner?

name: create_group_vote
title: Create group vote
